source_inspection.author: Rebecca Sload
source_inspection.title: Radiocarbon Dating of Teotihuacán Mapping Project TE28 Material from Cave under Pyramid of the Sun, Teotihuacán, México
source_inspection.inspected: PDF printed pages 13-26, Tables 1-2, Figures 6,10,11 inspected visually beyond abstract
source_inspection.uninspected: Original 1978 field notebooks; original lab sheets; Sugiyama et al 2013 full paper

findings.subject: Area B eastern posthole and possible basalt laja floor
findings.evidence: Beta-220750 beneath Beta-220749 in posthole: 1870±40 and 1810±40 BP respectively; calibrated 2σ 60–240 CE and 110–330 CE. Beta-220747 1910±40 BP 2σ 20–220 CE in adjacent BYCT. No intact concrete floor in this area; original laja floor hypothesis unconfirmed.

findings.subject: Area D western entrance: sequence below intact concrete floor
findings.evidence: Beta-220766 in basal fill 1930±40 BP 2σ 10 BCE–140 CE; Beta-220764 hearth 1890±40 BP 2σ 40–230 CE; Beta-220763 hearth 1760±40 BP 2σ 150–390 CE. Floor laid after deposits; precise construction year uncertain.

findings.subject: Blockages 11-12 dated fires and shell/fish-bone deposit
findings.evidence: Beta-220753 1810±40 BP, 220756 1750±40 BP, 220758 1790±40 BP near blockages; author suggests related sealing episode but overlapping 2σ ranges cannot prove a single event.

findings.subject: South Transverse Chamber sample and ceramic counts
findings.evidence: Six of 273 total TE28 sherds in Area A, all Tzacualli/Miccaotli; Beta-220743 and 220744 early under concrete, 220745 later; reconcile with V97 four disturbed sherds subset.

findings.subject: Stratigraphically anomalous sample Beta-220760
findings.evidence: Sample dated 1830±40 BP 2σ 90–260 CE from lowest fill versus Beta-220754 1970±40 BP 2σ 50 BCE–110 CE in another lowest fill; source calls 220760 anomalous.
